blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Team captain Jia De Guzman and Angel Canino remain determined to help Alas Pilipinas women to finish strong in the Asian Games 2026 volleyball tournament despite bombing out of medal contention. The Philippines was eliminated from the quarterfinal race after a 29-27, 24-26, 23-25, 19-25 loss to Kazakhstan on Thursday at Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium. Canino, who played her best Asian Games outing yet with 24 points, said they gave their all, but it wasn’t enough, as the Kazakhs proved to be the more composed team down the stretch. “I’d say we really did our best today.
